meta.description:
Thanks to IFL Watches for sponsoring this video! Check out their hand-painted watches here: https://bit.ly/ironsnailIFLW and IG here: https://www.instagram.com/iflwatches_ae/

I'm no good at Summer. I like it when it's cold outside. So here is 12:47 seconds of me trying to figure out what to wear in the summer. We're talking chambray, linen, double cloth, TROUSERS, etc. Also, I'm not sure if anyone reads this but it was my goal to do a video in under two weeks and I DID! Amped!
